title: GPU Computing
details: Wrote CUDA kernels that hit speedups of up to 774x on matrix multiplication. I also built an autograd tensor library from scratch in CUDA C++: a tiny PyTorch, minus the years of work.

title: Quantum Computing
details: Helped build a multi-tenant quantum simulator that lets several users share qubits on classical hardware. I wrote the Qiskit tooling that measured workload per qubit and proposed Kubernetes-based scheduling for a shared quantum cluster.

title: Image Segmentation
details: Implemented iterative thresholding for the Chan-Vese segmentation model in MATLAB and Python, adding convolution and region-specific information. False positives dropped by 40%.
